full_prompt_en: A square anime character illustration shows two young fantasy adventurers standing full length against a plain warm cream background. The ground is only suggested by faint gray shadows beneath their feet, so the clothing designs carry nearly all visual detail. At left, a smiling blond youth with short windswept hair and blue eyes faces outward. A dark sleeveless high-collared top sits above loose white trousers marked with large ochre ornamental shapes. A tan sash and layered belts cross the waist, and pale armguards cover the forearms. Brown wraps and pale sandals finish the outfit at the ankles. The hands rest casually near the hips, giving the figure an open, relaxed pose. At right, a slightly taller pale-haired youth stands at a three-quarter angle with long blond-white hair flowing to the side and violet eyes. A white diagonal upper cloth crosses dark purple sleeves and fitted shoulder pieces. Wide deep indigo trousers, purple patterned hanging panels, golden belt fittings, dark shin coverings, and pale shoes create a more layered costume. One hand rests at the waist while the other arm bends outward. Both figures have fine clean outlines and lightly shaded faces; hair locks taper into sharp soft points. The large costume shapes are flat and graphic, but fabric folds, metal clasps, and embroidery receive small highlights and texture. Diffuse frontal light keeps the faces bright and casts short soft shadows below, with no dramatic background lighting. There is no scenery or readable text. The overall composition is balanced and airy, placing warm white-and-gold on the left against cooler violet-and-cream on the right in generous negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画人物插图呈现两名年轻奇幻冒险者，全身站在素净暖奶油色背景前。地面只由脚下淡灰影略作暗示，因此服装设计承载几乎所有视觉细节。左侧，一名微笑的金发少年迎面站着，短发被风吹开，眼睛呈蓝色。深色无袖高领上衣搭配宽松白裤，裤上有大型赭金色装饰形。棕黄色腰带与层叠皮带横过腰部，浅色护臂包住前臂。脚踝处的棕色绑带和浅色凉鞋完成装束。双手轻松放在髋旁，姿态开放自然。右侧，一名稍高的浅发少年以四分之三角度站立，长金白发向旁边飘，眼睛呈紫色。白色斜披上衣横过深紫袖子和贴身肩甲。宽大的深靛蓝裤、带紫色纹样的垂片、金色腰带配件、深色胫部护具与浅色鞋形成更复杂的服饰。一只手放在腰间，另一臂向外弯曲。两人都有细而干净的轮廓与轻柔阴影面容，发束收成锐利而柔软的尖端。大服装色块平坦而图形化，但衣褶、金属扣和刺绣带少量高光与肌理。漫射正面光让面容明亮，只在脚下留下短柔影，没有戏剧化背景照明。画中没有景物或可读文字。整体构图平衡而通透，以左侧暖白金色对照右侧较冷的紫色与奶油色，周围有宽裕留白。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration emphasizes clean full-form silhouettes, elegant tapered linework, and layered ornamental color blocking. Warm cream and gold balance cool violet, indigo, and charcoal without making the palette harsh. Large fabric planes stay simple enough to read at a glance, while clasps, patterned inserts, and narrow trim add detail only in selected zones. Hair and other soft edges flow in long curved strokes; harder fittings have crisp geometric boundaries. Even diffuse light provides gentle volume and short contact shadows, leaving the surrounding field nearly blank. Paired forms can be differentiated through costume density and warm-cool balance while sharing a consistent drawing language. The overall effect is polished, buoyant, and decorative.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅动画插图强调干净的完整剪影、优雅收尖的线条和层叠装饰性色块。暖奶油色与金色平衡冷紫、靛蓝和炭色，配色却不刺眼。大布面足够简单，一眼可读，扣件、纹样嵌片和窄滚边只在选定区域增加细节。头发等柔软边缘由长弯线流动，较硬配件有清晰几何边界。均匀漫射光提供轻柔体积和短接触影，周围色场几乎空白。成对形体可通过细节密度与冷暖平衡区分，同时共享一致绘画语言。整体效果精致、轻快而富于装饰性。
theme_en: Two colorful fantasy adventurers standing on a plain cream background
theme_zh: 两名色彩明快的奇幻冒险者站在素净奶油色背景前
name: Genshin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
